symptoms: SIRS Criteria (Adults): Temp <36°C or >38°C, HR > 90, RR > 20 or PaCO2 < 32, WBC < 4 or > 12 or >10% immature band forms.
qSOFA Adults: Altered mental status GCS < 15, Tachypnoea RR >= 22, Hypotension SBP <= 100.

management_steps.details: Measure lactate level. Remeasure lactate if initial lactate elevated (> 2 mmol/L).
Obtain blood cultures before administering antibiotics.
Begin rapid administration of 30 mL/kg crystalloid for hypotension or lactate >= 4 mmol/L.
Apply vasopressors if hypotensive during or after fluid resuscitation to maintain a mean arterial pressure >= 65 mm Hg.

warnings: SIRS is not specific to sepsis — can be found in trauma, post-surgery, burns, pancreatitis, acute inflammatory conditions.
